outcome: Progression and persistence of lower urinary tract symptoms (LUTS) other than urinary incontinence
cohort: 2534 women aged 30-79 years of black, Hispanic, or white race and/or ethnicity
finding: Having two or more vaginal childbirths, uterine prolapse, and gestational diabetes (in younger women) were associated with a higher risk of developing or experiencing worsening LUTS over a 5-year period.
mod_finding: Women who had delivered 2 or more children vaginally had higher odds of LUTS progression compared to women with no vaginal deliveries.
